# Chengguang Battery Tools
> Free interactive automotive battery finders, calculators, and cross-reference tools for battery buyers, mechanics, and distributors.

## Tools
- [Battery Finder](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/finder/): Find the correct battery for your vehicle (Make→Model→Engine→Region)
- [CCA Calculator](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/cca-calculator/): Calculate required Cold Cranking Amps from engine specs and climate
- [JIS↔DIN Cross-Reference](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/cross-reference/): Interactive cross-reference with dimension comparison and fit warnings
- [Runtime Calculator](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/runtime-calculator/): Estimate battery runtime under accessory load
- [Life Estimator](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/life-estimator/): Predict remaining battery life by age, climate, and usage
- [Ah↔CCA Converter](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/ah-cca-converter/): Bidirectional Amp-hours to Cold Cranking Amps conversion
- [Terminal Guide](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/terminal-guide/): Interactive decision tree for battery terminal identification
- [Reserve Capacity Calculator](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/reserve-capacity-calculator/): Estimate reserve-capacity minutes from Ah and load
- [Battery Bank Sizing](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/battery-bank-sizing/): Size RV/marine/solar banks with 12V/24V series-parallel config
- [AGM vs EFB vs SLI Selector](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/battery-technology-selector/): Recommend battery technology from vehicle, start-stop, and climate

## Articles
- [What is CCA?](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/articles/what-is-cca/): Complete guide to Cold Cranking Amps
- [Battery Life by Climate](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/articles/battery-life-by-climate/): Climate-specific battery recommendations
- [How to Test a Car Battery](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/articles/how-to-test-battery/): 4 testing methods with decision flowchart
- [Car Battery Buying Guide](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/articles/battery-buying-guide/): 5-step selection process
- [Battery Maintenance Tips](https://tool.chengguangenergy.com/articles/battery-maintenance/): Monthly checklist and seasonal care

## Ecosystem
- [Main Site](https://chengguangenergy.com/): Factory, certifications, contact

- [Technical Center](https://technical.chengguangenergy.com/): Technology, engineering, testing
